description: Hold a 36-hour expanded-product quote using a workspace key, print-ready PDF and 1–100 US recipients. Returns the exact expiration in expiresAt (UTC). Uploads artwork to DirectMailAmerica for live pricing; no charge or mailing. Each PDF page must match catalog dimensions; postcards require one landscape front artwork page. Two-sided postcard: pro_postcard_85x55, doubleSided:true, color:true, plus reverseMessage OR reverseArtworkBase64; the server assembles two pages. Maximum 25 MiB combined artwork. Staging quotes are demo estimates. Obtain approval of artwork, addresses and total before sending.

doubleSided.description: Two-sided postcards: productId pro_postcard_85x55, true, color:true, plus exactly one reverse input. Other postcard sizes remain single-sided.

pdfBase64.description: Base64 PDF, maximum 25 MiB decoded. Every page must match the selected product dimensions; postcards require one landscape front artwork page. For pro_postcard_85x55 with doubleSided:true, supply reverseMessage OR reverseArtworkBase64 separately; the server assembles two pages. No raw image files.

reverseArtworkBase64.description: For pro_postcard_85x55 with doubleSided:true only: one unrotated PDF page, fitted into the 282 × 348 point reverse left area. No raw images, added bleed or crop marks. Choose this OR reverseMessage. Front and reverse together: maximum 25 MiB decoded.

reverseMessage.description: For pro_postcard_85x55 with doubleSided:true only: plain text on the reverse left side, maximum 21 wrapped lines. Choose this OR reverseArtworkBase64. Unsupported glyphs and overflow are rejected.

name: quote_product

outputSchema.description: Read operation first for financial/mail state and recovery. Optional service fields are absent on failure. Unknown is not zero or permission to retry. Legacy service fields remain available.

amountCents.description: USD cents. Null means not applicable or not known; never interpret null as zero.
